description: This Java class defines a builder for creating immutable Feature objects, supporting JSON-based initialization and fluent API methods for setting feature properties.

classes.name: ImmutableFeatureFromScratchBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing Feature objects, supporting JSON initialization and fluent property setting.

methods.name: newFeatureFromJson
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance initialized from a JSON object representing a Feature.

methods.name: newFeatureFromScratch
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a Feature from scratch.

methods.name: useId
methods.description: Sets the feature ID for the Feature being built.

methods.name: definition
methods.description: Sets the FeatureDefinition for the Feature.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Sets the FeatureProperties for the Feature.

methods.name: properties
methods.description: Sets the FeatureProperties from a JsonObject.

methods.name: withId
methods.description: Alias for useId, sets the feature ID.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs and returns the final Feature object.
